title: DMC3 HD NBZ ZIP Backend — Phase 14

records.title: NBZ archive backend uses standard ZIP EOCD, central and local headers
records.summary: The canonical DMC3 archive backend indexes NBZ volumes through standard ZIP structures: EOCD signature 0x06054B50, central-directory signature 0x02014B50 and local-file signature 0x04034B50. The index stores entry name, compression metadata, sizes, CRC32 and local-header/data relationships for later lookup/read.

locations.note: VA 0x140327CC0. Phase-14 disassembly contains the standard EOCD/central/local ZIP constants and builds the archive entry index from those structures.
VA 0x140328160. Lookup operates over the built archive entry index.

records.title: NBZ entry read separates direct stored reads from compressed inflate reads
records.summary: The ZIP entry stream distinguishes direct stored-byte reads from compressed-entry reads that pass through a dedicated inflater path. This establishes a transformation boundary: compressed archive storage offsets are not equivalent to offsets inside the materialized resource bytes.

locations.note: VA 0x140328F50. The read path uses direct archive bytes for stored entries and the inflater state for compressed entries.
VA 0x140328820. Dedicated compressed-entry materialization path. The complete real-corpus compression-method domain remains a separate validation question.

records.title: DMC3 NBZ volumes are mounted as an ordered archive family
records.summary: The DMC3 resource bootstrap mounts numbered DMC3-N.nbz archive volumes through the archive-mount backend. Archive mounts participate in the VFS archive-provider pass rather than becoming a separate top-level asset authority.

locations.note: VA 0x140326DA0. Phase-14 bootstrap evidence links numbered DMC3 NBZ volumes to this ZIP-compatible archive backend.
